summary.text: Caleb Price is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 30, on Cincinnati's west side, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mike Odioso.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a union member and barista and said his priorities include fair funding for public schools, affordable health care and housing.

paragraphs.text: Caleb Price graduated from Walnut Hills High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois Chicago in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Cincinnati and graduated from Cincinnati Public Schools.

Price said in the survey that he supports a single-payer health care system that Ohio residents could opt into, property tax relief for the middle class and seniors without abolishing property taxes, and fully funding schools through the Fair School Funding Plan.
He also listed public transportation, clean energy, affordable college and gun reform among his policy interests.
